title: Slab concatenation + FlashMixer kernel with async KV coalescer and continuous-batching horizon
author: Maya Chen
body: Context: Operator-level profiling in the last quarter showed sustained stalls on small-to-medium sequence lengths due to scatter/gather overheads and suboptimal KV warmup for bursty traffic. This PR introduces a new attention strategy (SlabConcatenate + FlashMixer microkernel) that reduces per-token overhead for heterogeneous sequence distributions and a lightweight async-KV coalescer that amortizes KV cache population across micro-batches. Motivation: 1) Reduce small-batch latency and increase throughput at mid-sequence lengths (256-2048) where customer workloads spend most of their tokens. 2) Retain deterministic rotary/rope semantics while enabling a fused concatenate path that avoids extra memcpy for tiled KV layouts. 3) Improve continuous batching horizon so runtime can opportunistically stretch batching without violating latency SLOs. What this change does: - Introduces FlashMixer microkernel: a variant of Flash-attention style tiling that mixes slab-concatenated Q/K/V regions to minimize memory fragmentation and enable a single fused rotary application pass. Optimized for 8-16 head widths on A100/RTX7x. - Adds SlabConcatenate path to the kernel selector with heuristics based on sequence length distribution and current batch skew metric. This path fuses concatenation, rotary application, and QK matmul into one kernel for contiguous slabs. - Implements Async KV Coalescer: a runtime stage that coalesces concurrent KV writes from overlapping micro-batches into a single GPU write and exposes a KV warmup metric. Coalescer has backpressure safety to avoid overpopulation for very long sequences. - Extends continuous batching horizon: runtime now computes an elastic horizon that trades a small p99 latency tail against higher throughput; this is governed by a new config: continuous_batching.max_horizon_ms and continuous_batching.tail_target_pct. - Preservation of model semantics: fused rotary/rope ops are designed to be numerically identical to the existing path (FP16 accumulation path validated). Testing & benchmarks: - Microbenchmarks (internal harness) show 9-14% throughput uplift and 6-10% median latency reduction at seq=512/1024 for T5-like models and ~12% on LLaMA-variant runs with head dim 64. - KV-heavy chat workload (continuous small messages) showed 18% cost improvement due to reduced redundant KV writes. - Extensive regression tests validate logits and sampling for baseline prompts and prompt sets in eval harness. Rollout plan: gated feature behind runtime flag slab_concat.enabled; rollout to canary clusters for 2 weeks; if no regressions, flip on in dedicated pools with auto-fallback to legacy path. Related: ENG-4821 (kv warmup telemetry), ENG-4899 (batching SLOs), SUP-3210 (customer-reported chat latency spike). Notes: this PR intentionally avoids global allocator changes and keeps the fused kernel opt-in. The body below includes a short appendix with file-level highlights and a summary of reviewer discussion and CI details.

review_comments: Ethan Park (2025-11-20): Can we add a safety net where the coalescer refuses to merge KV writes if the estimated cold-miss rate exceeds X? Please add a metric for coalescer_rejects.
Maya Chen (2025-11-20): Added coalescer_rejects metric and a tunable threshold; left default conservative (0.05).
Sofia Ramos (2025-11-24): The fused rotary pass looks good, but please add a unit test for odd head sizes and a numeric comparison at fp16 with huge batch sizes.
Maya Chen (2025-11-25): Added test and adjusted accumulation order to match baseline for odd head dims. Benchmark noise decreased.
Luca Bianchi (2025-11-28): CI flaked on int8 quant tests; please verify kernel compiles with quantized execution path.
Maya Chen (2025-11-29): Fixed linker issue in ops/Makefile and added a guard for quantized path to fallback to standard kernel (optional). CI green afterwards.
ci_summary: All CI checks passed after fix. Unit tests: 512/512. Integration tests: 98/98. Bench harness ran locally and in CI with smoke runs. Lint: pass. Built artifacts: linux-cuda12 (A100), linux-cuda11 (RTX series).
release_notes: Introduces SlabConcatenate + FlashMixer fused attention kernel (opt-in). Adds Async KV Coalescer and continuous_batching horizon config. Expected throughput uplift 8-14% for mid-tail sequences and improved KV write efficiency for chat workloads. Rollout gated behind slab_concat.enabled.
